selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the special message that this person carries?
questions.answer: He carries the Qur’an from Allah.

questions.question: Who accepts this message in every century?
questions.answer: More than 300 million people accept it.

questions.question: How many ways does the passage say this message is amazing?
questions.answer: Seven ways.

questions.question: What book is named for explaining the Qur’an’s miracles in detail?
questions.answer: The Twenty-Fifth Word.

questions.question: About how many sides of miraculousness are mentioned for the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Forty sides.

questions.question: Why does the passage say the traveller does not explain all those proofs here?
questions.answer: Because they are explained in another work.

questions.question: What job does the person have with this message?
questions.answer: He brings it to people and announces it.

questions.question: Why would lying be a very serious wrong for the one who brings this message?
questions.answer: It would go against the message and betray Allah.

questions.question: What does this passage teach us about the truthfulness of the messenger?
questions.answer: He must be truthful and cannot be a liar.

questions.question: What is the main idea of this passage?
questions.answer: The Qur’an is a great miracle, so the one who brings it is trustworthy.

questions.question: In whose hand is the decree said to be?
questions.answer: In the hand of the messenger.

questions.question: Who is the decree from?
questions.answer: It is from the Lord of the universe.

questions.question: What is this decree called?
questions.answer: It is the Qur’an.

questions.question: How do many people respond to this decree over time?
questions.answer: They accept and confirm it century after century.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Qur’an besides being a decree?
questions.answer: It is wonderful and miraculous.

questions.question: What shows that the Qur’an is not an ordinary book, according to the passage?
questions.answer: It has many miraculous signs.

questions.question: Why is another treatise mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: It gives strong proofs about the Qur’an’s miraculous nature.

questions.question: What does the traveller conclude about the one who delivers the decree?
questions.answer: He cannot be lying.

questions.question: If that person lied, whom would he wrong?
questions.answer: He would wrong Allah, Who sent the decree.

questions.question: What connection does the passage make between the Qur’an and the messenger’s honesty?
questions.answer: Bringing Allah’s message shows he must be honest.

questions.question: What kind of writing is the Qur’an called in this passage?
questions.answer: It is called a decree.

questions.question: Who sent this decree?
questions.answer: The Creator and Lord of everything sent it.

questions.question: How long has this decree been accepted by huge numbers of people?
questions.answer: Through every century.

questions.question: What number is given for the people who accept it?
questions.answer: More than 300 million people.
